title: The NEW Boys: Mystic & Stream
description: A high fantasy steampunk theme modpack featuring Create: Aeronautics as its backbone.
body:
![The NEW Boys: Mystic & Steam Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/908db9827e55df7032f599dd4b72dbf859f0045e.png)

**Features so far...**

- Contains [Create 6.0](https://modrinth.com/mod/create) and [Create Aeronautics](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-aeronautics)! 
- Fly across endless seas of configurable floating islands thanks to [Sky Archipelago](https://modrinth.com/mod/sky-archipelago) by Sathrek with variety of biomes done by [Oh The Biomes We've Gone](https://modrinth.com/mod/oh-the-biomes-weve-gone)!
- Hundreds of structures given by [Create: Structures Arise](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-structures-arise), [Create: Easy Structures](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-easy-structures), [Moog's Soaring Structures](https://modrinth.com/mod/mss-moogs-soaring-structures), and more!
- Revamped vanilla structures all done by Lukidonu's collection! ([Luki's Strongholds](https://modrinth.com/mod/lukis-strongholds), [Luki's Grand Capitals](https://modrinth.com/modpack/the-new-boys-mystic-stream/settings/description))
- Plentiful of magic to upkeep the high fantasy feel! ([Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks](https://modrinth.com/mod/irons-spells-n-spellbooks) and [Ars Nouveau](https://modrinth.com/mod/ars-nouveau), [Artifacts](https://modrinth.com/mod/artifacts), etc)
- Decorative mods such as [Chimes (1.21.1)](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/chimes), [Handcrafted](https://modrinth.com/mod/handcrafted), and [Chipped](https://modrinth.com/mod/chipped).
- And, [Farmer's Delight](https://modrinth.com/mod/farmers-delight) and [Bountiful Fares](https://modrinth.com/modpack/the-new-boys-mystic-stream/settings/description) are included with compatibility mods!

This modpack was done for personal friends and the pack is subject to changed with additional features as time goes on, however, will not stray away from fantasy and steampunk. Feel free to download and play to your leasure!
